preregistration_source_head_subject: D2 A2R2 repair target-scoped evaluation accounting
preregistration_commit_note: preregistration_source_head is the repository HEAD at which this preregistration was authored and frozen (the D2-A2R2 closeout commit). The later ND-0A commit that introduces this artifact file into history is created after this file is written; its SHA is intentionally not recorded and must not be invented.

binding.manifest_review_state: review_status=approved, reviewer=Li, human_approval=complete, accepted_count=28, revise_count=0, rejected_count=0
binding.readme_statement: evaluation/novel/v1/README.md records that no PANDA Agent retrieval, QA, judge, runtime evaluation, or novel evaluation has run for this curation.
binding.note: The no-outcome statement is bound to the manifest governance fields (agent_outcome_seen_before_freeze, evidence_selected_from_agent_output) and the human curation review records, not merely to the absence of run files.

production_roles.note: Recorded verbatim as provenance only. ND-0 performs no promotion or demotion of any role.

measurement.case_count_contract: 28/28 full frozen set; no sampling; no cohort splitting for the primary measurement
measurement.production_retrieval_configuration: Current production retrieval path, unchanged for ND-0B: production exact LEGACY_EXACT; sparse the exact raw question; RawDense production-authoritative with SemanticDense KEEP_DISABLED; fusion P0 CURRENT production-authoritative; selector CURRENT_SELECTOR production-authoritative; D2 shadow resolver not applied in the production retrieval path.

metric_contract.name: recall_at_5
metric_contract.definition: Fraction of required evidence groups matched among the top-5 ranked candidate object IDs, using the authoritative frozen evidence-group matcher (panda_agent.evaluation).
metric_contract.applicability_note: Ordinary-applicable only for expected_status=answered cases (27 of 28; novel_dev has 27 answered and 1 insufficient_evidence). Denominator per case follows the evaluator's native metric_applicability mechanism. No new relevance semantics are introduced for novel_dev.

metric_contract.name: recall_at_10
metric_contract.definition: Fraction of required evidence groups matched among the top-10 ranked candidate object IDs.
metric_contract.applicability_note: Answered cases only (27 of 28); evaluator metric_applicability denominators apply as-is.

metric_contract.name: recall_at_20
metric_contract.definition: Fraction of required evidence groups matched among the top-20 ranked candidate object IDs.
metric_contract.applicability_note: Answered cases only (27 of 28); evaluator metric_applicability denominators apply as-is.

metric_contract.name: mrr
metric_contract.definition: Mean reciprocal rank of the first required-evidence-group match within the top-20 ranked candidate object IDs.
metric_contract.applicability_note: Answered cases only (27 of 28); evaluator metric_applicability denominators apply as-is.

metric_contract.name: combined_candidate_recall
metric_contract.definition: Fraction of required evidence groups matched within the combined channel candidate pool (the pre-selection candidate union fed to fusion and final selection).
metric_contract.applicability_note: Answered cases only (27 of 28); evaluator metric_applicability denominators apply as-is.

metric_contract.name: critical_evidence_recall
metric_contract.definition: Fraction of required evidence groups marked critical=true that are matched within the final selected evidence set.
metric_contract.applicability_note: Supported by the novel_dev schema (required_evidence_groups entries carry critical flags); ordinary-applicable for answered cases only (27 of 28).

metric_contract.name: final_evidence_recall
metric_contract.definition: Fraction of required evidence groups matched within the final selected evidence set produced by the retrieval path.
metric_contract.applicability_note: Answered cases only (27 of 28); evaluator metric_applicability denominators apply as-is.

measurement.relevance_semantics_rule: Existing authoritative evaluator semantics are reused unchanged. Evaluation questions are measurement data, not implementation specifications; no question-specific relevance handling is introduced.
measurement.model_call_policy: Total model calls are NOT preregistered as zero. The current production retrieval path may legitimately use model/API-backed components (query analyzer, dense embedding, reranking where applicable); production retrieval is not changed to reduce cost. Only the prohibited-stage counters above are preregistered at zero.
measurement.failure_handling: If infrastructure failure interrupts ND-0B, partial runs are preserved and handled explicitly; partial runs are never silently redefined into a completed measurement.

stratified_reporting.freeze_rule: Aggregate reporting plus existing frozen curation-metadata groupings only. Groupings are frozen before any outcome exists; no post-outcome grouping schemes are permitted.
stratified_reporting.aggregate: Full 28-case aggregate first; strata reported as counts and rates within strata.

supporting_metadata.intent: coverage_report.json counts_by_intent and curation_metadata.yaml per-record intent
supporting_metadata.evidence_multiplicity: coverage_report.json multi_evidence_count and per-record evidence-group counts
supporting_metadata.family: curation_metadata.yaml curation_family_id (28 independent families) with family class as recorded in the frozen sidecar
supporting_metadata.disposition: manifest representativeness dispositions and curation_metadata.yaml representativeness.disposition

stratified_reporting.small_dimension_policy: Dimensions with very small cell counts (for example cross_repository=1, paper_only=2) are reported as counts only, without strong comparative claims.
stratified_reporting.protection: No protected novel_validation or external-holdout metadata is exposed by this reporting contract.

comparison_reference.role: Existing Gold retrieval baseline frozen as the comparison reference BEFORE any novel_dev outcome exists. No new Gold benchmark is run for ND-0.
comparison_reference.selection_rule: Selected by pre-outcome provenance and configuration compatibility from the existing baseline inventory under evaluation/baselines/.

selected_reference.cohort: 24 English Gold v2.6 questions (fixed selection manifest with frozen case IDs and reuse rule)

rejected_alternative.reason: Preserved 1-question retrieval and QA smoke artifacts only; its own scope field states 'Preserved 1-question retrieval and QA smoke artifacts; not the A3 baseline' and it is superseded_by english-gold-stratified-bootstrap-v1-20260813. Not usable as a reference.

comparability_supports: Both measurements are retrieval-only and use the same authoritative evaluator metric semantics (evidence-group matcher).

Retrieval channel roles are unchanged across the interval per the lifecycle role statements recorded at C6/C7/D1/D2 closeouts: production exact LEGACY_EXACT; sparse the exact raw question; RawDense production-authoritative with SemanticDense disabled; P0 CURRENT fusion production-authoritative; CURRENT_SELECTOR production-authoritative; D2 shadow resolver not applied in the production retrieval path.

Index identity unchanged: embedding gemini-embedding-2 (3072 dimensions), sparse Qdrant/bm25, index schema v2; REEMBEDDING_REQUIRED=false, INDEX_REBUILD_REQUIRED=false, QDRANT_SCHEMA_CHANGE_REQUIRED=false through the preregistration source head.
mismatch_dimensions: NON_IDENTICAL_COHORT: 24 Gold v2.6 questions vs 28 novel_dev questions; different question sets and intent mixes; the Gold baseline has no evaluated data_flow, module_structure, or troubleshooting questions while novel_dev includes them.

ANALYZER_GENERATION: the baseline was measured at prompt_set_version 3.6.0; the current production prompt set is 3.7.0 (PROMPT_SET_VERSION in src/panda_agent/prompts.py); C6-A1R1 recorded 0/46 current-plan channel-input compatibility with the frozen 3.6.0-era streams, so the query-analysis layer changed after the baseline.

PROVENANCE_COARSENESS: the baseline was executed from base commit e132acce (2026-08-12) with a dirty working tree; that provenance predates the Phase C evaluation-infrastructure work and Phase D (D1/D2).

reporting_plan.unavailable_metric_policy: If either side lacks comparable support for a metric, that cell is marked UNAVAILABLE rather than synthesized.
reporting_plan.interpretation_rule: The gap is an approximate cross-cohort indication under the recorded mismatch dimensions. It is not an apples-to-apples effect estimate and is never used alone to justify production changes.

diagnosis_taxonomy.purpose: Generic failure-class diagnosis of ND-0B misses; categories are classes of unseen questions, never question-specific labels.
rules: Category names are frozen before outcomes; ND-0C may refine naming to current architecture only where a name does not map to an existing mechanism, and must record any such refinement.
No question-specific categories, trigger phrases, expected symbols, paths, answers, quotas, or weights may be created from diagnosed cases.
INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE and UNCLASSIFIED are explicit outcomes; an infrastructure failure is never counted as a retrieval failure.
EXPECTED_EVIDENCE_MAPPING_ISSUE and EVALUATION_CASE_ISSUE record suspected dataset-side causes; they are diagnoses, not justifications for editing frozen Gold.

development_rule.after_nd0b: After ND-0B finishes, novel_dev becomes DEVELOPMENT_EXPOSED; later development may use it for generic debugging and iteration.
development_rule.artifact_protection: ND-0 artifacts, including this preregistration, must never be overwritten by later novel_dev iterations.
development_rule.rerun_identity: Future novel_dev reruns use new run/checkpoint identities; they never overwrite ND-0 run or checkpoint records.

novel_validation_state.protection_rule: ND-0 does not run novel_validation, does not inspect outcomes on it, and does not use it to select or tune anything.

external_holdout_registration_reference.registration_record: evaluation/novel/v1/external_holdout_manifest.json (created by a separate ND-0A workstream; this artifact records only the user-authorized non-sensitive registration metadata and does not duplicate or depend on that record's content)
external_holdout_registration_reference.boundary: This preregistration does not locate, inspect, or describe the external holdout content and records no real filesystem path for it.
